verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Antigravity 2.0 as a central command center, a unified platform to launch, monitor, and orchestrate agents. They document parallel agents across independent projects, conversations grouped into Projects, and Git worktree isolation for background agents. Remote Control extends this to driving desktop sessions across machines from a browser, and the CLI also supports multiple parallel agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the multi-session manager, and detailed documentation of how session monitoring and status views work in practice.
